title: Caseworker cannot see cases assigned to a colleague

articles.subject: Caseworker cannot see cases assigned to a colleague
articles.body:
Hi,

I am covering for a colleague who is on leave until September. I can find her cases in the search but when I open one I get "You do not have access to this case". Applicant 2026-0455 has called twice asking for a decision and I cannot even read the file.

Can you give me access to her cases for the rest of August?

Karin

articles.subject: Re: Caseworker cannot see cases assigned to a colleague
articles.body:
Hi Karin,

Access to another caseworker's cases is granted by a unit administrator in Grantly, we cannot do it from our side without an approval from you. Anna Lind is an administrator for your unit, she can add you as a deputy under Unit > Deputies.

I have written a short note on how to do it below, feel free to forward it to her.

Kind regards,
Sara Holm

articles.subject: Re: Caseworker cannot see cases assigned to a colleague
articles.body: Anna added me as deputy this morning and I can open them now. Thanks.
